git_commit: pre-registration: the commit that adds this file, BEFORE any E036 code exists; code: not written; run: not run
status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN. Master plan 'Safe signal research', Phase 2. It runs only after Phase 3 reproduces E013/E018 exactly (the gate below) and only on the user's go-ahead for Phase 3 onward. Research-only, offline, development data only. move_size_1h_v1, its shadow record and its registered checkpoints are untouched whatever happens.
why: The 2026-10-17 signal inventory proposed one small, zero-cost batch. MS-A is its move-size comparison: does the one candle-derived liquidity measure the programme has never put INSIDE the fitted model add information about next-hour move size beyond the nine reference inputs? A thin market turns the same order flow into a bigger move (Amihud illiquidity), and a change in mean trade size is the classic proxy for informed rather than retail flow. Both inputs come from fields the live move-size track already fetches every hour, so a positive answer would have a zero-cost route to a future prospective test; a negative one closes the line.
duplicate_check: Not answered before. E015 tested amihud_rel_168 and trade_size_rel_24 only fit-free, one at a time, against forward returns (bar |rho| >= 0.10 in both periods; both found nothing): a marginal association test, not their contribution inside a model. E018 measured REMOVING each of the reference's groups (volatility -61%, trade intensity -18%, calendar -6% of skill) and its forward selection searched only the nine reference inputs; E022 repeated that against a volatility-scaled target. No experiment has added any shape input to the move-size model. Removal is therefore NOT re-run (E018 answers it); its figures are only cited.
hypothesis: Adding log(amihud_rel_168) and log(trade_size_rel_24) to the nine-input E013 model improves the Brier score of the calibrated probability that the next hour's absolute return exceeds 0.25%, on identical development rows, by a statistically clear and practically useful margin, without worsening calibration or ranking.
target_and_horizon: y = 1 if |close(as_of + 1h) / close(as_of) - 1| > 0.0025 (build_frame target 'large_move', threshold 0.0025, horizon 1 h): E012/E013's registered definition, unchanged.

inputs.reference: E013's nine inputs, unchanged: tr_mean_14_rel, rv_24, rv_168, vol_ratio_24_168, trades_rel_24h, trades_rel_168h (these six log-transformed; values <= 0 treated as missing), hour_sin, hour_cos, is_weekend (agent/research/feature_count.FULL, LOG_FEATURES).
inputs.candidate: The same nine plus amihud_rel_168 and trade_size_rel_24 (agent/research/shape.py, unchanged definitions; point-in-time tested in tests/test_shape_features.py), both log-transformed exactly as the reference treats its other strictly positive ratio inputs (values <= 0 treated as missing). No other transform, window, subset or feature is tried.

model: L2 logistic regression, C = 0.1 (LogisticModel; its scaler fitted on each fold's training rows only), Platt calibration fitted on each fold's purged 90-day slice at the end of its training range (E013's chosen variant), applied to that fold's test block. Every fit, scaler and calibrator uses training-window rows only.

data.permitted: Development period only, through the governed readers (agent/research/snapshots.py): spot candles btcusdt_1h_2026-09-19.csv (68,868 development rows, sha256 8a87f7d4d2fea636c43479439c0ee7d99afd474ec6be805283892ab48fd35d63) and trade counts klines_extra_btcusdt_1h_2026-09-20.csv (68,868 development rows, sha256 04f0a2a0eed976cb5a683be8af8f79aee66a6681a9ee156448ff33c30dac7fa8), plus the derived replay cache data/replays/replay_btcusdt_1h_2026-09-19_2017082713_2025063023_p0.2.0_s0.2.0.csv (sha256 accf1a73d665e91bf04f2cb556d23d2de90197a269de128496f763e0c164c0fb; it supplies the row index and period labels only).
data.boundaries: Reference hours 2017-08-27 13:00 -> 2025-06-30 22:00 UTC (the last hour whose 1 h outcome candle closes before the holdout). Exploration = before 2024-01-01; validation = 2024-01-01 -> 2025-06-30.
data.never: The sealed holdout (2025-07-01 -> 2026-08-19; research/HOLDOUT_ACCESS.log must still not exist afterwards), the 30-day buffer, any live or shadow record, any news score, any macro, derivatives or on-chain data, any download.

validation_design: E013's: expanding walk-forward, min_train 365 days, 90-day test blocks, purge = 1 h + 24 h embargo on both sides of the calibration slice, calibration slice 90 days (WalkForwardSpec(horizon_hours=1, scheme='expanding', min_train_days=365, test_block_days=90, embargo_hours=24, calib_days=90)). Rows are restricted ONCE to hours where every reference AND candidate input and the label exist; folds are built from that common index; reference, candidate, base rate and EWMA rule are all scored on exactly those test rows. The number of rows lost relative to E013's 64,180 frame rows (expected: a few hundred hours after each candle gap, where amihud_rel_168's ~192-hour window is not yet complete) is reported, with the per-fold training and test row counts.
baselines_on_identical_rows: the reference (above), re-run on the common rows
the in-period observed base rate (the denominator of 'skill', E013/E018/E019 convention)
E019's free 24 h EWMA rule (simple_baselines.simple_rules -> 'E_ewma_halflife_24h', no fitting; the standing reference for every move-size result)

metrics.primary: Validation paired Brier difference d = Brier(reference) - Brier(candidate) (positive = candidate better), on the common rows.
metrics.secondary: Per period: Brier, skill = 1 - Brier / Brier(in-period base rate), log loss, ECE (10 equal-width buckets), E013's bucket rule, calibration intercept and slope, Spearman rho(p, |return|), mean stated vs observed; the paired difference per calendar year 2018-2025; both models vs the EWMA rule; the candidate's coefficient signs across folds (descriptive).

uncertainty: Paired 48 h circular block bootstrap of d, 2,000 resamples, seed 31 (agent/research/metrics.block_bootstrap_estimates through simple_baselines.paired_difference: the E018/E019 settings). Percentile 95% interval. Two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 * min((1 + #{d* <= 0}), (1 + #{d* >= 0})) / (1 + 2,000)) from the same resamples.
multiple_comparisons: The move-size family of this batch has exactly ONE comparison (MS-A), so Holm at family-wise alpha = 0.05 equals the unadjusted test. The batch as a whole has three comparisons (this one and E037's two); the direction family is corrected separately in E037. Years and periods are descriptive and never used to choose, tune or rescue anything.
practical_threshold: The project's existing bar for added complexity (E019, E020, E032 H_b): the candidate's validation skill must be at least 1.10 times the reference's on the same rows. In Brier terms: d >= 0.10 * skill(reference) * Brier(in-period base rate), about 0.0025 at E013's validation values (0.10 * 0.0983 * 0.2494). It is copied from those experiments, not chosen for this candidate.
calibration_requirement: E013's rule, unchanged: validation ECE <= 0.03 AND every bucket with >= 100 rows within 0.05; exploration ECE <= 0.03.

what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.SUPPORTED: All of: (S1) validation d > 0 with p < 0.05; (S2) d at or above the practical threshold; (S3) the exploration point estimate of d is also > 0; (S4) the candidate meets the calibration requirement; (S5) d > 0 in at least 6 of the 8 calendar years 2018-2025 (E032's year rule, applied to the difference); (S6) validation rho(p, |return|) not lower than the reference's by more than 0.02 (E013's C2). Meaning: offline, hypothesis-generating evidence of incremental value. It authorises NOTHING by itself: the smallest next step would be a written proposal for a separately registered prospective shadow track of a NEW frozen model id, which needs the user's approval; move_size_1h_v1 is never changed.
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.NOT_SUPPORTED: The upper end of the validation 95% interval of d is below the practical threshold (the data exclude a practically useful gain), OR the candidate fails the calibration requirement (disqualified, as in E020/E031/E035). Meaning: on this target, horizon, model and development data, the illiquidity and trade-size pair does not add a practically useful amount to the reference. It does NOT say the features are useless for every target or horizon. The line is closed: no other liquidity or trade-size variant, window or transform is tried.
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.INCONCLUSIVE: Anything else (for example a statistically clear gain below the threshold whose interval still reaches it, or an interval that includes zero and the threshold). Recorded as such; not converted into either answer; no follow-up variant.

tripwire: A candidate validation skill of at least 1.5 times the reference's (the E020 tripwire) stops the experiment before any verdict: implausible for two inputs that E015 found uninformative alone, so the point-in-time path of the new inputs is investigated first.
phase_3_gate_before_any_candidate_run: The reference must first reproduce E018's full model (= E019's incumbent = E013's Platt variant) on E013's own rows: 27 folds; 41,345 exploration and 13,127 validation out-of-sample rows; validation Brier 0.22486794688851872, skill 0.09831058812130411, ECE 0.013908212033160137, rho 0.360210573019641; exploration Brier 0.21357448100603457, skill 0.1457009719998531; and E019's EWMA rule validation Brier 0.2394624303810767 (skill 0.03978872487148288). Tolerance 1e-9 absolute (same machine, code and bytes: E018, E019 and E035 reproduced E013 to the digit). A larger difference stops the move-size track; the cause is found and documented, and nothing is changed to make it match.
stop_rules: Stop this track if: the reference does not reproduce; a data boundary or timestamp cannot be verified (the governed reader refuses a file); the candidate needs any data beyond the permitted files; reference and candidate cannot be scored on identical rows; a test exposes a possible leak; the tripwire fires and is not explained; or the implementation deviates from this record. A failed or stopped candidate is never re-run under a changed method as the same experiment.
validation_wear: About 35 experiments have examined these development periods; E012, E013, E018-E022 and E031/E035 fitted and judged move-size models on exactly these rows. Whatever MS-A finds is HYPOTHESIS-GENERATING, not confirmation. Only a separately registered prospective track (or, once, the sealed holdout, a user decision) can confirm.
expectation_stated_in_advance: NOT_SUPPORTED or INCONCLUSIVE is the likely result: E015 found nothing for either input alone, E018 found the model already over-featured (six inputs reach 99.4% of its skill), and the practical bar asks for about +10% skill from two inputs. A pass would be surprising and would be checked hardest.
compute_and_storage: Local only: one reproduction run, one reference and one candidate walk-forward on the common rows, the EWMA rule and the bootstraps; expected well under 15 minutes on this laptop (E035, of similar size, ran in 56 s plus bootstraps). Output under research/results/E036/ (JSON + markdown, < 5 MB). No network, no AI call, no database, no workflow, no new table, no paid service.
